primary_download_location: Product Documents section; PDF hosted through an expiring signed download URL. Unsigned link returned403. Advertised LCSC link returned HTML; no stable direct PDF link positively verified.
verification_method: Rendered exact manufacturer drawing pixels and cross-checked extracted vector text; component-side PCB view determines numbering, not mirrored bottom view.
component_side_coordinate_system: Pin1=(0,0); +X moves from contact1 toward contact3/contact4; +Y faces mating nose.
nose_offset_derivation_mm: 7.90+8.89-2.54=14.25 from pin1/front-contact row; body center X=-1.91+7.50/2=1.84; body sides=center±11.10/2.
project_copper_land_choice: 1.80×1.80 contacts, 0.90mm drill, pin1roundrect/othersround; manufacturer drawing specifies hole diameters and locations, not copper land diameter.
initial_shared_library_finding: Right locating post drill=3.25 instead of exactdrawing3.20. All other numbered contacts/postcenters/body/F.Fab extents match. Root and both CAD agents notified; import only after rightdrill correction.
qualification_limits: Geometry review only. Mating plug dimensions, cable pin reversal, CAN signal quality, power voltage drop, current protection, thermal margin and unplated home-board assembly still require physical prototype qualification.
